ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) surface with high-intensity (white) pixels localized at the distal tips and along specific segments of the trailing edge.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous dark-gray/black mass across the majority of the fluke surface; high-contrast white mottled clusters located at the distal tips of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch at the central upper boundary, approximately 35-45 degrees, with a deep bounding-box penetration into the fluke mass.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous, high-frequency serration along the upper boundary with irregular pixel-amplitude peaks and valleys extending from the notch to the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave upward sweep of the trailing edge lobes transitioning into convex terminal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized high-contrast white pixel clusters at the distal tips of both lobes, indicative of barnacle attachment scarring.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint vertical linear pixel disruptions (parallel rake marks) visible on the medial-to-lateral region of the viewer-left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent nicks and irregular indentations along the trailing edge; extensive white depigmentation scarring at the lateral tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Heavy water spray and droplet patterns occluding the lower-central pixel region where the fluke meets the water surface.
